notes.title: Goulash and paprika! Hungarian Voiceover is Here!
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!

We’re absolutely thrilled to bring you a feature that’s been a long time coming: [b]full Hungarian voiceover[/b]! This update is particularly close to our hearts, and we know many of you have been eagerly awaiting it.

This isn’t just any update. Our Hungarian voiceover includes performances from both seasoned professionals and new talents. We’ve poured our hearts into making sure every line is delivered with passion and authenticity.

While the Hungarian voiceover is the star of this update, we’ve also included several tweaks and fixes to keep everything running smoothly. Your gaming experience is our top priority!

We’re overjoyed to finally bring this feature to our Hungarian players, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we’re always here to listen.

Happy gaming, and enjoy the new voiceover!

[i]Egészségedre![/i]

notes.title: Major Update - 27/06
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow gamers!

We're super excited to share our latest update, and trust us, it's a big one. We've packed it with all sorts of goodies to make your gaming experience even better. Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Smarter AI[/b] - Tired of the AI making dumb moves? Not anymore! We’ve given our AI a major brain boost.
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] - Get ready for some multiplayer mayhem! You can now play with your Steam friends. Woohoo!
[*][b]In-Game Feedback Panel[/b] - Got something to say? Now you can tell us what you think without ever leaving the game. We’re all ears (or, you know, eyes).
[*][b]Detailed End Result Screen[/b] - More stats, more details, more satisfaction. Check out the new end result screen for a full breakdown of your performance.
[*][b]Mercy for the defeated[/b] - Lost a betli or durchmarsch on your second turn? No need to suffer through the rest. These games will now end automatically when the solo player loses. You're welcome!
[*][b]Forfeit option[/b] - Stuck in a hopeless game? Now you can gracefully bow out and move on to the next challenge.
[*][b]Extermination[/b] - We’ve hunted down and squashed those pesky bugs you reported. The invisible text issue on Mac? Gone. We hope... Thanks for helping us make the game better!
[/list]

So, what are you waiting for? Get your buddies and start dealing those cards! And as always, keep the feedback coming. We’re here to make this game the best it can be, with your help.

Game on!

PS: The [b]Hungarian voice over [/b]sadly did not make it to this update, but it is very close to being finished. If you want to check out where it is now, you can do so by switching to the "preview" beta in your Steam client! You can always switch back to the standard version, anytime you want. Just don't forget to set the audio language back to English [b]BEFORE [/b]changing versions!

notes.title: It's sneak peek time with our new beta!
notes.notes:
Hey, adventurers! Are you curious to see what's coming to Behind the Beyond:Ulti? This is your chance to get your hands on upcoming features, tweaks, and surprises before anyone else.

As part of our beta crew, you'll be the first to check out new stuff, break things (in a good way!), and most importantly, share your thoughts. Whether it's smashing bugs, tweaking mechanics, or uncovering hidden easter eggs, your feedback helps us shape the game into something truly special.

[b][u]How to jump in:[/u][/b]
1. Locate the game in your Steam client and open up "Properties" from the context menu (right click).
2. Go to "Betas" tab
3. Select the "preview" branch from the dropdown.
4. Play the game!

We're all ears! Share your wildest ideas, craziest bugs, and most epic moments with us. 
Hit us up in [url=mailto:sugarpunchgames@gmail.com]email[/url], join our [url=http://discord.gg/fcmJt65Prm]Discord server[/url], or simply use the in-game feedback tools (available in the preview branch).

notes.title: Behind the Beyond: Ulti Arrives March 1st!
notes.notes:
As the official card game of Hungary, Ulti holds a special place in the hearts of many, representing a cherished aspect of Hungarian heritage. Now, players worldwide can immerse themselves in the card game through Behind the Beyond: Ulti.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762540/6a5332233c752a648be6df65215f635907ef9dae.png[/img]

With tutorials tailored for beginners, even those new to the game can dive in and experience Ulti firsthand. The game also features Steam achievements and leaderboards, adding an extra challenge for seasoned players looking to test their skills.

In this exciting game release, players will have the opportunity to go head-to-head against the characters of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148310/Behind_the_Beyond/]Behind the Beyond[/url], a unique point-and-click adventure game that delves deep into Hungarian folklore. For those who wish to experience both games without spoiling the story, Behind the Beyond: Ulti will offer a "spoiler-free" option, allowing players to enjoy the card game without impacting their experience of the main adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762540/ec99251d644f07ac4339509f1533df81ea797b12.png[/img]

Behind the Beyond: Ulti comes fully equipped with English and Hungarian text, as well as a complete English voiceover. More languages, including Hungarian voiceover are coming soon!

Mark your calendars and get ready to play Ulti - on Steam from 1st March, 2024.
